description: This file defines a custom attribute class 'TypeManifestProviderAttribute' used to specify a metadata provider type for an assembly in the Orleans.Serialization.Configuration namespace.

classes.name: TypeManifestProviderAttribute
classes.description: A sealed attribute class used to specify a metadata provider type for an assembly, ensuring the type implements ITypeManifestProvider.

methods.name: TypeManifestProviderAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a provider type, validating that it is not null and implements ITypeManifestProvider.
